notes: Two completely different derivation rules keyed on `major >= 26` (lines 224-231), both real in this corpus (the server has already crossed the scheme boundary MSC 1's own P7.3 findings noted for Minecraft itself). Classic (major < 26): `"1.\(major).\(minor)"`, or just `"1.\(major)"` when minor == 0 -- always gets the "1." prefix. New scheme (major >= 26): `"\(major).\(minor)"` with NO "1." prefix, or just `"\(major)"` when minor == 0. A build-number component beyond the first two (the third/fourth dotted segments, e.g. the ".0.61" in "26.2.0.61") never appears in the derived Minecraft version at all -- only comps[0]/comps[1] are read (line 228).
